limits: No atomic snapshot across API calls and no native Forgejo shape or permission proof.
Before merge refreshes full review set and verifies signature; after merge checks expected FF and selected approval only.
Caller must hold a previously verified binding; no authorization, signature, protection proof or deployment is produced.
A revoked approval after merge blocks a future decision, without undoing the merge.
scope: read-only before/after merge rechecks, invented Forgejo responses and real invented validation signatures
